links.title: Follow the beginner course
links.description: A chaptered introduction covering media, editing, Fusion, color, audio and delivery. Use the chapter list to choose a starting point, and check interface differences against your Resolve version.

links.title: Start the Fusion chapter
links.description: Jump to the course's introduction to the Fusion page at 1:43:14. Follow this section when you want to move from timeline editing into compositing.

links.title: Start the color chapter
links.description: Jump to the Color page chapter at 2:50:20. Choose this section if you already know basic editing and want to explore grading.

links.title: Set up Resolve Color Management
links.description: Jump to the setup section of Kelly’s 2024 color management lesson. It covers project-level settings and the role of the timeline color space.

links.title: Work through Color Space Transform settings
links.description: Use this chapter if you already work with grading nodes and want to understand the settings of Resolve’s Color Space Transform.

links.title: Try the free timeline track lesson
links.description: Follow a lesson on adding B-roll and working with video and audio tracks. It covers track destinations, locking and back-timing an edit.

links.title: Review the DaVinci Resolve for Editors course
links.description: A paid course with practice footage for editors moving to Resolve, including from Premiere Pro. The curriculum covers editing, grading, sound and delivery using Resolve Free where possible.

links.title: Start learning Fusion
links.description: A beginner course covering node-based compositing, masks, animation and 3D. The provider offers free access through its account and checkout flow.

links.title: Browse practical tutorials
links.description: Explore worked examples for Fusion compositing and Resolve workflows.

links.title: Explore Fusion expressions
links.description: Examples for simple expressions, masks and timing, with explanations for learning how they work.

links.title: Find Fusion scripting references
links.description: Entry points to the Fusion and composition API references. Check the documentation and your Resolve setup before running a script.

links.title: Follow the official training programme
links.description: Choose training videos, books and lesson files for editing, grading, audio and compositing. Match the material to the Resolve version you use.

links.title: Repair noisy dialogue in Fairlight
links.description: A free Resolve 21 lesson on recognizing audio problems, removing hum and clicks, and reducing background noise.

links.title: Follow the free Fairlight training series
links.description: Work through the exercises in Blackmagic Design’s Fairlight Audio Guide with video demonstrations by Yadlovski.

links.title: Track camera movement and calibrate a lens
links.description: A free lesson on drawing calibration lines for lens distortion and using supervised Camera Tracker inputs in Resolve 21.1.

links.title: Browse the free Fusion tutorials
links.description: Find techniques for tracking paint strokes, removing objects and placing 3D objects in a tracked shot.

links.title: Start the free Portuguese Resolve mini-course
links.description: Short beginner lessons in Brazilian Portuguese. The free lessons appear at the top of a page that also offers paid training.

links.title: Start the free Hindi Resolve crash course
links.description: An introduction to the course and core workflows, including media organization, editing, color and audio. The interface may differ from newer Resolve versions.

links.title: Choose a free French editing or grading masterclass
links.description: Choose an edit that goes from import to export or a color lesson that grades a real shot. Both videos are publicly available.

links.title: Review the Resolve editing course outline
links.description: A paid course that builds an edit with supplied project files, then covers workflows such as multicam and conforming. The provider lists Spanish, English and Portuguese audio and subtitles.

links.title: Explore the short-film grading workshop
links.description: A paid workshop recording with practice footage. It teaches node organization, color management and shot matching using a narrative short film.
